description: Hi! I'm Meera, a Grade 12 student from the UAE interested in space, science, and creative ideas. My project is about creating a guide for the first astronaut on Mars to help them prepare for the challenges of exploring the planet. I'm looking for teammates who are creative, hardworking, and interested in space, with skills in research, science, design, or problem-solving!
summary:
Project Name: MarsNavigator Pro
Team Name: Three to the Stars
MarsNavigator Pro is an interactive Mars map designed to guide the first astronaut on their journey to exploring the Red Planet. Since being the first astronaut on Mars means facing unfamiliar environments and challenges, our project aims to provide a detailed navigation and survival guide that prepares astronauts for different situations they may encounter.
The map includes important missions, their objectives, and step-by-step instructions on how to accomplish them. It also provides essential survival and safety guides, covering personal hygiene on Mars, refilling oxygen tanks, growing potatoes for food, and maintaining astronaut safety. Additionally, it includes weather information to help astronauts understand Martian conditions, determine whether it is safe to explore, and follow the necessary precautions when weather becomes dangerous.
We developed MarsNavigator Pro using Base44, an AI-powered development platform. We used prompts and code to generate the initial map and its features, then contributed our own inputs, edits, and improvements to shape the final project.
Our main goal is to create a practical, informative, and interactive guide that helps the first astronaut navigate Mars, complete essential missions, and make safer decisions while exploring an unfamiliar planet.
details:
MarsNavigator Pro

Team Name: Three to the Stars

1. Introduction

MarsNavigator Pro is an interactive Mars navigation and survival guide designed to assist the first astronaut exploring the Red Planet. Being the first human to step onto Mars comes with many challenges, including unfamiliar terrain, extreme weather conditions, limited resources, and the need to complete important scientific missions.

Our project aims to provide astronauts with a detailed and accessible map that helps them navigate Mars, understand their surroundings, complete essential missions, and prepare for unexpected situations. Rather than simply showing locations, MarsNavigator Pro combines navigation, mission instructions, weather information, and survival guides in one interactive platform.

2. The Problem

The first astronaut on Mars will face an environment that humans have never experienced directly. Without an established human presence, the astronaut will need reliable information to make decisions, complete missions, and maintain their safety.

Some of the main challenges include:

• Navigating unfamiliar Martian terrain.

• Understanding weather conditions and deciding when it is safe to explore.

• Maintaining personal hygiene in a limited-resource environment.

• Monitoring and refilling oxygen supplies.

• Finding sustainable ways to produce food.

• Knowing what precautions to take during dangerous environmental conditions.

A general map would not be enough to address all these challenges. Astronauts need a more detailed guide that connects their locations with the missions, instructions, and safety information relevant to each situation.

3. Our Solution: MarsNavigator Pro

We developed MarsNavigator Pro as an interactive map that brings together the essential information an astronaut may need during their first exploration of Mars.

The platform allows users to explore different locations, discover available missions, follow instructions, and access survival information. It is designed to make important information easier to find and understand, helping astronauts prepare for both planned activities and unexpected challenges.

4. Main Features

A. Interactive Mars Map

The main feature of MarsNavigator Pro is its interactive map. It allows users to explore different areas of Mars and access important locations and information through the map.

Users can identify exploration points, view the missions associated with them, and learn about the steps required to complete each mission.

B. Missions and Exploration Objectives

The map includes different missions that guide the astronaut through important exploration activities.

Each mission includes its objective and the steps needed to accomplish it. This helps organize the astronaut’s activities and provides a clearer understanding of what needs to be completed during the exploration.

C. Martian Weather and Safety

MarsNavigator Pro includes weather information to help astronauts understand the environmental conditions before exploring.

It also provides safety guidance explaining:

• Whether current conditions are suitable for exploration.

• What environmental dangers astronauts should consider.

• What precautions to take when weather conditions become dangerous.

• When it may be necessary to postpone outdoor activities and remain in a protected habitat.

D. Oxygen Supply and Refilling

Oxygen is essential for astronaut survival. This section explains the importance of maintaining oxygen supplies, monitoring available oxygen, and understanding the process of replenishing oxygen tanks using suitable life-support systems.

E. Hygiene and Personal Care

Maintaining hygiene on Mars is important because astronauts will live in a confined environment with limited water and other resources.

This section provides guidance on personal hygiene, conserving water, and keeping equipment and spacesuits clean to support a healthy and safe living environment.

F. Growing Potatoes and Producing Food

Since transporting all food from Earth would be challenging for long-term missions, astronauts may need to explore ways of producing food on Mars.

This section introduces the possibility of growing potatoes in controlled environments, such as specially designed greenhouses. It explains the importance of providing suitable growing conditions and managing resources to support plant growth.

5. Technology and Development

We developed MarsNavigator Pro using Base44, an AI-powered application development platform.

Our development process involved:

• Using prompts and code to generate the initial application and map.

• Providing the instructions and information needed for the different features.

• Editing and improving the generated content and layout.

• Adding our own inputs to shape the missions, navigation, and survival guides.

• Reviewing the different sections to make the platform more useful and accessible.

Although we used an AI development tool to assist with creating the application, our team contributed to directing the development process, selecting the information, and editing the final result.

6. NASA Resources and Scientific Relevance

MarsNavigator Pro is based on the challenges associated with human exploration of Mars, including its environment, weather, resource limitations, and the requirements for astronaut survival.

NASA’s Mars exploration research and resources provide important scientific context for understanding the planet and preparing for future human missions.

Our project connects these areas of research to an interactive guide that demonstrates how scientific knowledge can be applied to practical exploration and astronaut safety.

7. Expected Impact

MarsNavigator Pro aims to make Mars exploration more organized, understandable, and accessible by bringing several important aspects of astronaut preparation into one platform.

Its expected benefits include:

• Helping astronauts navigate unfamiliar Martian locations.

• Providing organized mission objectives and instructions.

• Raising awareness of environmental dangers and safety precautions.

• Supporting better understanding of oxygen management and resource conservation.

• Introducing possible approaches to food production on Mars.

• Making complex space exploration topics easier to understand through interactive learning.

8. Conclusion

MarsNavigator Pro is more than an ordinary map. It is an interactive exploration and survival guide designed around the challenges of being the first astronaut on Mars.

By combining navigation, missions, weather awareness, and essential survival information, our project aims to help prepare for the difficulties of exploring an unfamiliar planet.

Through Three to the Stars, we hope to contribute an innovative educational concept that demonstrates how technology, scientific research, and creative problem-solving can support the future of human space exploration
